guideTitle: The Best Docking Stations for Dell Laptops
metaTitle: Best Docking Stations for Dell Laptops: SD25TB4, WD22TB4 and Alternatives (2026)
metaDescription: We compared Dell's SD25TB4, WD22TB4 and WD19TBS docks with Plugable, Anker and HP alternatives on charging, Thunderbolt support, displays and price.
introParagraphs: For a Dell Latitude, XPS or Precision, Dell's own docks have one clear advantage: Dell says they negotiate full rated charging with Dell laptops, which third-party docks may not match. They also fit Dell's IT management tools.

Dell's range here runs from the Thunderbolt 3 WD19TBS to the Thunderbolt 4 WD22TB4 and the newer SD25TB4 Smart Dock with 2.5GbE and Wi-Fi. Third-party docks from Plugable, Anker and HP are included for anyone who also connects non-Dell laptops or wants a lower price.
Our comparison is based on published specifications and price position, not hands-on testing. Prices range from about $98 to $279 at the time of writing.

dell-sd25tb4-pro-smart-dock.summary: Dell's SD25TB4 Smart Dock bundled with a 180W adapter, 8K support and a three-year warranty.
dell-sd25tb4-pro-smart-dock.description:
This SD25TB4 configuration is the top Dell option: a Thunderbolt 4 Smart Dock bundled with a 180W adapter, supporting 8K output, with HDMI, DisplayPort and Thunderbolt cables included and a three-year warranty.

The 180W adapter suits higher-power Dell laptops. It is the most expensive dock here at about $279 at the time of writing.
dell-sd25tb4-pro-smart-dock.bestFor: Precision and other high-power Dell laptops.
dell-sd25tb4-pro-smart-dock.skipIf: Your Dell needs 130W or less; the 130W SD25TB4 costs about $55 less.

dell-pro-sd25tb4-smart-dock.summary: The SD25TB4 Smart Dock with 130W, up to four displays, 2.5GbE and Wi-Fi.
dell-pro-sd25tb4-smart-dock.description:
The 130W SD25TB4 is the sensible default for most Dell business laptops: Thunderbolt 4, up to four displays through two DisplayPort 1.4 and HDMI 2.1, and built-in 2.5GbE and Wi-Fi.

It costs about $225 at the time of writing.
specs: Up to 4 displays (2 x DP 1.4, HDMI 2.1)
dell-pro-sd25tb4-smart-dock.skipIf: You want to save; the WD22TB4 costs about $40 less.

dell-wd22tb4-thunderbolt-dock.summary: Dell's previous-generation WD22TB4 with Thunderbolt 4 and 130W.
dell-wd22tb4-thunderbolt-dock.description:
The WD22TB4 is Dell's previous-generation Thunderbolt 4 dock with 130W charging and multiple display outputs, for about $185 at the time of writing.

It lacks the SD25TB4's built-in Wi-Fi and 2.5GbE but covers most Dell setups for less.
dell-wd22tb4-thunderbolt-dock.bestFor: Dell Thunderbolt laptops on a tighter budget.
dell-wd22tb4-thunderbolt-dock.skipIf: You want 2.5GbE; the SD25TB4 has it.

dell-wd19tbs-thunderbolt-dock.summary: Dell's entry Thunderbolt 3 dock with 130W for about $122.
dell-wd19tbs-thunderbolt-dock.description:
The WD19TBS is the cheapest Dell dock here: a Thunderbolt 3 dock with 130W charging and multiple USB and display ports, for about $122 at the time of writing.

It is an older Thunderbolt 3 design, but it works with many Dell laptops and keeps Dell's charging behavior.
dell-wd19tbs-thunderbolt-dock.skipIf: You want Thunderbolt 4; the WD22TB4 has it.

plugable-tbt-udm-thunderbolt-4-dock.summary: Plugable's certified, driverless Thunderbolt 4 dock for Dell, Mac and other laptops.
plugable-tbt-udm-thunderbolt-4-dock.description:
The Plugable TBT-UDM is the choice if a Mac or non-Dell laptop also uses the dock: certified Thunderbolt 4, driverless, 100W charging, dual 4K HDMI or single 6K, six USB ports, SD and Ethernet.

At 100W it may charge high-power Dell laptops more slowly than Dell's 130W docks.
plugable-tbt-udm-thunderbolt-4-dock.skipIf: Only Dell laptops use it; a Dell dock charges at full rate.

anker-prime-docking-station-14-port.summary: Anker's 14-port, 160W dock marketed for Dell, HP and Lenovo.
anker-prime-docking-station-14-port.description:
The Anker Prime is a 14-port USB-C dock with up to 160W total output, dual 4K and 10Gbps data, marketed for Dell, HP and Lenovo laptops, with a status display for troubleshooting.

It costs about $170 at the time of writing.
anker-prime-docking-station-14-port.bestFor: Mixed-brand Windows desks with many peripherals.
anker-prime-docking-station-14-port.skipIf: You want Dell's management and charging; choose a Dell dock.

plugable-usb-c-triple-display-dock.summary: A Plugable DisplayLink dock for one 4K 30Hz and two 1080p 60Hz displays.
plugable-usb-c-triple-display-dock.description:
This Plugable dock adds three displays through DisplayLink: one 4K at 30Hz and two 1080p at 60Hz, with 100W charging and six 5Gbps USB ports.

The 4K output at 30Hz feels less smooth, and DisplayLink needs a driver. It costs about $160 at the time of writing.
plugable-usb-c-triple-display-dock.bestFor: Adding three monitors to a Dell that cannot drive them natively.
plugable-usb-c-triple-display-dock.skipIf: Your Dell supports enough displays natively; a Dell dock is simpler.

hp-usb-c-dock-g5.summary: HP's 11-in-1 G5 business dock, listed as compatible with Dell and other USB-C laptops.
hp-usb-c-dock-g5.description:
The HP G5 is the cheapest dock here at about $98 at the time of writing: an 11-in-1 business dock listed for USB-C and Thunderbolt laptops, including Dell machines.

It will not use Dell's charging protocol, and its wattage is not listed here, so check it against your Dell charger.
hp-usb-c-dock-g5.bestFor: Mixed HP and Dell offices on a budget.

buyingCriteria.explanation: Dell docks negotiate full charging with Dell laptops and fit Dell's management tools; third-party docks work across brands.
130W covers many Dell business laptops; high-power models may need 180W.
WD19TBS is Thunderbolt 3; WD22TB4 and SD25TB4 are Thunderbolt 4.
The SD25TB4 supports four displays and 2.5GbE; the Plugable triple-display dock uses DisplayLink.

faq.q: Do I need a Dell dock for a Dell laptop?
faq.a: Not necessarily, but Dell docks negotiate full charging with Dell laptops and fit Dell's management tools.
At least your Dell charger's wattage. Precision workstations may need 180W.
The WD19TBS is Thunderbolt 3 and works with many Dell laptops; Thunderbolt 4 docks offer newer features.

bottomLine: For most Dell business laptops, the SD25TB4 at 130W is the sensible dock, with the 180W bundle for high-power models. The WD22TB4 and WD19TBS are cheaper Dell options that keep Dell's charging behavior.
If other brands share the desk, the Plugable TBT-UDM and Anker Prime are the cross-brand alternatives.
